fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell Technology (MRVL) fell 6.4% on November 16 following Nvidia CEO change news, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell 1.6% and 2.2% respectively in the same period.
fields.summary_ko.1: MRVL faces shareholder dilution pressure from its $115 billion Lumentum acquisition, with SemiAnalysis projecting 2027 AI chip capex down 19% from prior estimates.
